summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software engineer, strong interest in functional programming (F#, Elixir, Racket, Clojure), passionate about visual programming languages (LabVIEW, TouchDesigner), critical of corporate practices and technology's impact on society, advocates for environmental sustainability and conservation, enjoys reading non-fiction, interested in computational metaphor and generative art, has a background in mathematics, prefers desktop applications over web apps, dislikes design changes in software that complicate usability, has a critical view of capitalism and wealth inequality, engaged in discussions about social and political issues, values ergonomic setups for programming, has a strong interest in programming languages and their ecosystems.
